senses.en_definition: Danger; something that may cause disaster, injury, or harm.

messages.en: I'm going down to the riverbank for a bit to take some photos. The water looks pretty fast today.
Hey, don't go down there. It's dangerous—the water's already up to that step! Just take your photos from up here.

senses.en_definition: Even; moreover; used to introduce an additional or more emphatic point.
Yes; an affirmative or deferential response (archaic).

messages.en: Did many people come to help you move yesterday?
Quite a few. Din didn't just help carry everything—he even treated everyone to a meal afterwards.
Wow, that was so nice of him! Even after all that tiring lifting, he still bought you all a meal.

senses.en_definition: That; a conjunction introducing the content of a statement, thought, or belief.

messages.en: I wrote “Saya percaya bahwa usaha ini akan berjaya”—“I believe this effort will succeed.” Is that sentence okay?
Change “bahwa” to “bahawa”. This is a Malay essay, so you need to use the Malay spelling.
Oh, no wonder the teacher marked it. I'll fix it now. Thanks!

senses.en_definition: Good; kind or morally well behaved.
Good; satisfactory, sound, or fit for use; still fresh or unspoiled.
Recovered from illness or injury; healed.

collocations.en: doing well; also “good news”, depending on context

senses.en_definition: All right; used to express agreement or willingness to do something.

messages.en: Could you check this file before it goes to the boss? I'm feeling a bit dizzy.
Sure, I'll check it in a bit. You get some rest first.
